translation.faq_p_18: Here you'll find answers to everything you wanted to know about DP STUDIO — from the natural variations between handmade resin and concrete items, through shipping options and preparation times, to special personalized gift orders. Every item that leaves our studio is one of a kind, and we're here to make you feel confident and satisfied at every step.

translation.faq_p_20: Everything you wanted to know about DP STUDIO, our items and the ordering process
translation.faq_p_21: Yes — this is one of the things closest to our hearts at DP STUDIO. Every item is handcrafted, and after the resin and concrete merge, a pattern is created that will never repeat itself. Shade, texture, veins and delicate details — all of these make each item completely unique. You receive not just a decorative object, but a small work of art that is incomparable.
translation.faq_p_22: Absolutely. We ship throughout Israel. Every item is carefully and lovingly packed so it arrives to you intact and perfect. Shipping time may vary depending on the area and volume, but we make every effort to ship within several business days from when the item is ready. You can contact us for exact details about costs and shipping options.
translation.faq_p_23: Of course, and we really love it. DP STUDIO items are special gifts for occasions like birthdays, weddings, housewarming, anniversaries and any other joyful event. You can request special gift wrapping and even add a personal blessing. Just mention this when contacting us and we'll take care of all the details.
translation.faq_p_24: Since every item is handcrafted and goes through several stages of production and processing — including drying and finishing time — the average preparation time is between 5 to 10 business days. Special or custom items may require additional time. We'll always update you throughout the process so you know when your item is on its way to you.
translation.faq_p_25: We're happy to hear ideas and try to adapt the item to the atmosphere and colors of your home. Contact us with your idea — shade, size, or style — and we'll get back to you with options and a customized price. Every such collaboration is an opportunity to create something that didn't exist before.
translation.faq_p_26: Our items are durable and designed for daily use, but like any quality object — they come to caring hands. It's recommended to wipe with a damp cloth only, avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight, and not to soak in water. Handmade resin and concrete trays will maintain their beauty for years when properly cared for.
translation.faq_p_27:
If you're looking for a special and impressive gift for an event, we recommend our sets that include a tray and double candle holder - a perfect combination of luxurious design and functionality.
The sets are especially suitable for challah separation, housewarming, Shabbats, holidays and meaningful personal gifts. Every item is handcrafted, so each gift is truly unique and moving.
translation.faq_p_28: Every item that leaves our studio is created by hand, with intention and love for materials. Here are some things that are important to know before ordering.
translation.faq_p_29: Every tray and decorative item is produced separately, so there may be slight differences in color, texture and finish between item to item. No two items are completely identical — this is exactly the soul of true handwork. The small differences are part of the uniqueness, not a flaw.
translation.faq_p_30: Every item is carefully wrapped and ready for shipping or personal delivery. We ensure that every product arrives to you intact and beautifully presented — whether for personal use or as a gift. Our items, like concrete and resin decorative pieces, arrive ready for gifting.
translation.faq_p_31: Have a question? Want to order a special gift and specify details like name, date or special request? We're here. At DP STUDIO we believe in personal connection with every customer — you can contact us at any time and we'll be happy to adapt the item to your needs.
translation.faq_p_32: We're here for you. Any question, special request or just a desire to hear more about our items — we'd love to hear from you and respond personally.

translation.home_p_19: At DP STUDIO we believe your home deserves pieces that tell a story. Every creation from handmade resin trays to decorative concrete and resin pieces — is crafted with care, with a full heart, and with emphasis on elegant and clean design that suits any space.
translation.home_p_20: Each piece is designed and handcrafted step by step, with attention to every detail. No two pieces are identical — each creation carries within it the energy and intention of the moment it was created.
translation.home_p_21: Our studio is located in Israel and we are proud of it. Every piece is created locally, from quality materials, with professional knowledge and genuine love for art and design.
translation.home_p_22: Due to the nature of resin and concrete materials, no two creations are identical. When you choose a piece from DP STUDIO, you receive something that no one else in the world can possess — special gifts for the home in minimalist design.
translation.home_p_23: Clean lines, natural textures and timeless decorative accents — every piece at DP STUDIO is handcrafted from resin and concrete, with luxurious finishing that gives every home its own unique character.
translation.home_p_24: At DP STUDIO, every piece is born from an intentional combination of resin and concrete — two materials that communicate with each other in creating rich, solid and elegant texture. The choice of materials is not accidental: it is the essence of our identity, and the foundation for every handcrafted decorative piece that leaves the studio.
translation.home_p_25: The resin and concrete are mixed in precise ratios, and cast into molds by hand. Each layer is poured carefully to create unique depth and texture that cannot be replicated.
translation.home_p_26: After the material stabilizes, each piece undergoes manual polishing and shaping — a stage where the final character of the piece is revealed. The finishing is done in layers, with full attention to every detail.
translation.home_p_27: Each piece is examined before it leaves the studio — touch, appearance, and weight. Only pieces that meet the highest standard are sent out.
translation.home_p_28: The natural variation between piece to piece is not a flaw — it is the soul of authentic handwork.
translation.home_p_29: Every piece at DP STUDIO is created by hand, with care and love — whether looking for a unique gift, a decorative piece for the home, or wanting to discuss personal customization. We are here for any question and conversation.
translation.home_p_30: You can also find us on Instagram and Etsy — where you can view additional works and stay updated on new pieces.

translation.about_h2_5: What makes every item from our studio unique
translation.about_p_20: DP STUDIO was born from a deep passion for handcraft and home design. Every item we create — whether a shiny resin tray or a minimalist concrete element — is the result of a slow and intentional process, where each stage is performed with care and thought. We believe your home deserves objects that tell a story.
translation.about_p_21: Our decorative items are made in Israel, in a unique combination of Resin and Concrete, giving each piece texture, depth and a finish that cannot be replicated. Every product is one of a kind — there is no other exactly like it in the world. This is not just decoration; this is the experience of owning something real and authentic.
translation.about_p_22: At DP STUDIO we believe that true beauty lies in the small details — in texture that invites touch, in color born from the material itself, in form that feels both modern and timeless. Every item we create carries within it the time, intention and love invested in it.
translation.about_p_23: The unique combination of resin and concrete allows us to work with contrasts: hardness and softness, transparency and depth, industrialism and elegance. The result is home decor items that feel personal and special — not because they are expensive, but because they are real. Every handmade resin tray, every bowl, every decorative item — is a conversation between the material and the hands that created it.
translation.about_p_24: We believe in "slow" — in intentional creation, in finishing that takes time, in patience that leads to results that last for years. Every item is made in Israel, in our studio, one by one — because otherwise it simply wouldn't be what it is.
translation.about_p_25: Every item carries a subtle variation that is part of its story — not a flaw, but a signature. This is what makes each piece unique.
translation.about_p_26: Every item at DP STUDIO is born from two unique materials — resin and concrete — which when they meet, create a stunning contrast between softness and strength, between shine and texture.
translation.about_p_27: Resin is the liquid soul of every item. In its fluidity it is liquid, transparent and soft — and when it hardens it becomes a deep and shiny layer that reflects light like a gemstone. We work with high-grade quality resin, and add pigments, nuances and marble effects by hand. Each casting is a unique gesture — it can never be reproduced exactly.
translation.about_p_28: Concrete brings weight, texture and earthiness. It is rough, matte, and full of character — but in the right hands it becomes a delicate and precise sculpture. We mix and prepare each concrete mixture ourselves, and adjust the granularity, color and weight for each product separately. Our concrete is not industrial — it is intimate, intentional and calculated.
translation.about_p_29: The real magic happens the moment resin and concrete meet. Shine versus matte, softness versus roughness, transparency versus opacity — all these create a design language that cannot be imitated. In every tray and decorative item from DP STUDIO, the two materials connect to form a complete creation: polished, unique, and with a presence that speaks for itself.
translation.about_p_30: Every DP STUDIO creation undergoes a meticulous handwork process — from the casting stage to the final finish. The slight difference between item to item is not a flaw, but evidence of the authenticity of each creation.
translation.about_p_31: Every item begins with a precise mixture of resin and concrete, prepared by hand and poured into unique molds. At this stage, pigments, textures and decorative elements are added that create the unreplicable character of each creation.
translation.about_p_32: After the casting stage, the item undergoes a controlled drying process. At the end of drying, each item is polished, smoothed and receives precise hand finishing — protective layers, texture polishing and treatment of small details that make each creation luxurious and ready for the home.
translation.about_p_33: Before the item leaves the studio, it undergoes a personal and meticulous quality check. We ensure that every finish, every edge and every detail meets DP STUDIO's high standard — only then is the item ready to find its home.
translation.about_p_34: Slight changes in shade, texture and pattern between item to item are an integral part of the character of true handwork — evidence that this is a unique and authentic creation, not mass production.
translation.about_p_35: At DP STUDIO, every item is created from love of material, respect for details and passion for design that feels real. These are the values that guide us in every creation.
translation.about_p_36: Every item is handmade, step by step, with attention to every single detail. There is no mass production — only true craftsmanship that is felt in the final finish.
translation.about_p_37: Our studio is located in Israel, and every item is created here, from raw materials to final packaging. We are proud to support local and authentic creation.
translation.about_p_38: Due to the nature of the materials — resin and concrete — no two items are completely identical. Each product carries within it an organic uniqueness that cannot be replicated, and that's exactly what makes it special.
translation.about_p_39: Our decorative items are designed for special moments — birthdays, housewarming, business gifts. Clean and elegant design that suits every home and every taste.
